India's GDP growth swung from a 5.8% fall in FY 2020-21 to a 9.7% rebound the next year, then settled around 6.5% to 9% (FY is April to March). These are from memory and later revisions can shift them a little, so please check the latest on the MoSPI site. I left out FY 2025-26 because I'm not sure of its final figure.

6:42 PM

The prices are launch prices in India for the base AI, from memory, so please check today's street price before buying. If you live in Apple's world, the iPhone 16 still makes more sense.
